plain: A wild, unreal idea or hope that cannot come true

webster.text: In fabulous history, a monster with three heads, that of a lion, of a goat, and of a dragon, vomiting flames.

more.text: In modern usage, a vain or idle fancy; a creature of the imagination, composed of contradictions or absurdities, that can have no existence except in thought.

example.quote: Among all the chimeras adduced on this occasion, we are intimidated with the fear of being attacked by the petty princes of Europe.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
